Kipu Quantum GmnH joins DLR's project "BASIQ: Battery materials simulation using quantum computers".

Kipu Quantum GmbH, a German quantum software company focusing on developing application-dependent and hardware-specific quantum algorithms that are commercialized as enterprise solutions, joins DLR's project "BASIQ: Battery materials simulation using quantum computers", which is part of the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative (DLR QCI).
This requires the development of quantum algorithms for very different classes of materials, the part of the project involving Kipu Quantum's technology.
